in_marathi.name: Adhrit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adhrit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Adhrit means one who is fearless and unassailable. It is derived from the Sanskrit word adhritah, which means 'unassailable, invulnerable'. This name is often given to boys who are expected to be strong, brave, and courageous.
